purpose: Rebuild Test pipelines of E26-E35 and compute the missing same-threshold LOSO rejection, so that W becomes available for candidates that only stored Test CSVs.

protocol.loso: leave-one-identity-out, 20 folds, prototypes never contain the scored block
protocol.threshold_rule: same percentile of the fold-level known-block scores as the original candidate

experiments.name: E26_final_candidates
experiments.pipeline: cov 原始特征 + SNR30 增广 + LR，距离型拒识；阈值 = Train 内层距离分位

experiments.name: E27_unknown_rejection
experiments.pipeline: 同 E26（E27B 只用 dist 八个工作点）

experiments.name: E28_dino_openset
experiments.pipeline: DINO cov5 / cov5+topo5 距离；阈值 = Train 内层距离分位

experiments.name: E29_dino_calibration
experiments.pipeline: DINO cov5 距离；阈值 = 10 个内层留出被试模型的 known 分位

experiments.name: E30_dino_multiview
experiments.pipeline: DINO 多视图分位融合（参考 = Train 内层已知分布）

experiments.name: E31_task_conditional
experiments.pipeline: 任务条件化中心 / 任务内 WCCN

experiments.name: E32_distance_ratio
experiments.pipeline: 任务内 WCCN 的 dist/ratio/gap 分位融合

experiments.name: E33_arcface_head
experiments.pipeline: ArcFace/CE 身份头（未保存权重，按原 seed 重训）

experiments.name: E34_covariance_hr
experiments.pipeline: 高分辨率协方差 DINO 特征 + 任务内 WCCN

experiments.name: E35_per_task_analysis
experiments.pipeline: cov5 任务内 WCCN，global / 逐任务阈值
